primary_endpoint: Percentage change from baseline in serum ALT at Week 16.
efficacy_outcome: ALT changed by −26.2%, −27.0%, and −44.9% with saroglitazar magnesium 1, 2, and 4 mg, respectively, versus +2.6% with placebo (p=0.0002, p=0.0001, and p<0.0001, respectively).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 1/26, 0/25, and 1/27 participants in the 1, 2, and 4 mg groups, respectively, versus 0/28 with placebo; no deaths occurred.
